title: Drywashing for Gold: Air, Dry Gravel, and the Right Machine
scope: Introductory editorial guide to dry placer concentration, with manufacturer-listed product examples. No equipment was independently tested or purchased.

sources.title: Placer Gold Recovery Methods — Special Publication 87
sources.publisher: Michael Silva; California Division of Mines and Geology, 1986
sources.location: Printed pp. 10–11, dry placers and dry washers
sources.supports: Air-through-fabric separation, agitation, dry disintegrated feed and fine-gold limitations.
sources.limits: Historical descriptions do not prescribe settings or recovery for current products.

sources.title: Silica and Worker Health
sources.location: Overview and where crystalline silica is found
sources.supports: Crystalline silica in soil, sand and rock; respirable dust and serious lung disease.
sources.limits: General hazard guidance; it does not measure exposure from these drywashers.

sources.title: Safe Work Practices — Silica
sources.location: Exposure prevention, engineering controls and respiratory protection
sources.supports: Control hierarchy, suitable ventilation/HEPA controls, avoidance of dry sweeping or compressed-air cleanup, and respiratory protection when controls are insufficient.
sources.limits: Workplace prevention principles, not validation of a hobby-machine dust retrofit or a claim about recreational legal requirements.

editorialMethods: Check moisture throughout a representative sample rather than judging only the surface
Record recovery-tray angle, air control, feed and starting bed condition separately
Compare repeated prepared portions while changing one control
Retain identifiable solid outputs without restricting designed airflow
Treat uncollected airborne fines and imperfect check recovery as accounting limits
notClaimed: A universal best drywasher angle, airflow, pulse rate or moisture percentage
That heated air makes wet clay suitable
That outdoor operation or a dustless label proves safe dust exposure
Product ranking, independent testing, current stock or complete package contents where unspecified
